node.title: Primitive exact-list local general-star budget
node.statement: At every x4 official row and every transported quotient row, fix the same support-wise first-match priority map used by the final list ledger. For every primitive residual full-prefix fiber F_z^prim and base support S0, the canonical map S -> (S\S0,S0\S) injects F_z^prim\{S0} into general order-t star-PTE records. Prove uniformly that |F_z^prim|-1<=16n^3-1, equivalently that the post-strip local general shift-pair degree is at most 16n^3-1. Then the actual primitive list column U_prim=max_z|F_z^prim| is at most 16n^3. A strip-aware injection into the F-4 minimal ledger plus u1_x4_direct_column_budget is one route; a direct bound on all surviving general records is another. The consumer requires only this local column bound.
node.falsifier: A consumed official or quotient row with a correctly stripped primitive full-prefix fiber containing more than 16n^3 actual list supports under the declared first-owner map.
